claims.claim: Zapier's plans are Free, Professional, Team and Enterprise. The Starter plan was discontinued on April 2, 2024 and Professional became the lowest-cost paid plan. Free is 100 tasks/month and two-step Zap workflows; multi-step Zap workflows require Professional or higher. Professional starts at $19.99/month annual ($29.99 monthly) for 750 tasks and scales by task tier within the same plan. Team starts at $69/month annual ($103.50 monthly).
claims.raw_snippet: As of April 2, 2024, the Starter plan will no longer be offered and the Professional plan will be our lowest-cost plan. Current Starter plan users were upgraded to the Professional plan and receive Professional features at no additional cost

claims.claim: Cardcom API v11 delivers transaction results by POSTing a JSON LowProfileResult body to a WebHookUrl supplied on the CreateLowProfile request, where WebHookUrl is a required field. Success is signalled by ResponseCode = 0; the credit-card transaction id is TranzactionId; cardholder details are nested under UIValues. Neither IndicatorUrl nor DealResponse appears anywhere in the v11 specification.
claims.raw_snippet: "CreateLowProfile": {"type": "object", "description": "create a new one time, Iframe \\ redirect page", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["TerminalNumber", "ApiName", "Amount", "SuccessRedirectUrl", "FailedRedirectUrl", "WebHookUrl"] ... "WebHookUrl": {"type": "string", "description": "A webhook URL is a web address that receives real-time data about the transaction", "maxLength": 500, "minLength": 1} ... "callbacks": {"single": {"WebHookUrl": {"post": {"requestBody": {"content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"nullable": true, "oneOf": [{"$ref": "#/components/schemas/LowProfileResult"}]}}}, "required": true}}}} ... "ResponseCode": {"type": "integer", "description": "if equel zero then success , else , a develper error see Description for more info"}
claims.verification_note: Downloaded the full spec (393KB) and counted occurrences: 'WebHookUrl' 11, 'InternalDealNumber' 5 (all on TransactionInfoRequest / SuspendedDeal lookup schemas, never on a webhook payload), 'IndicatorUrl' 0, 'DealResponse' 0, 'agorot' 0. info.version = '11.0', info.title = 'CardCom API'.

claims.claim: In the Cardcom v11 webhook payload, cardholder details are nested under UIValues (schema LowProfileUIValues) rather than at the top level.
claims.raw_snippet: "LowProfileUIValues": {"CardOwnerEmail": "Card Owner's email", "CardOwnerName": "Card Owner name.", "CardOwnerPhone": "Card Owner Phone.", "CardOwnerIdentityNumber": "Card Owner identity Number", "NumOfPayments": "number of payments for the deal", "CardYear": "Card expiration year.", "CardMonth": "card expiration month.", "IsAbroadCard": "boolean - is the card from isreal or is it a tourist card"}

claims.claim: Cardcom transmits amounts in decimal shekels, not agorot. No division by 100 is required.
claims.raw_snippet: "Amount": {"type": "number", "description": "Amount of tranzaction (12.36)", "format": "decimal"}
claims.verification_note: The substring 'agorot' appears zero times in the v11 specification. Request examples use values such as "Amount": 10.5.

claims.claim: The Israeli Invoice Reform allocation-number threshold is 5,000 NIS from June 2026 onward, measured on the amount before VAT. The step-down was 25,000 NIS in May 2024, 20,000 NIS in January 2025, 10,000 NIS in January 2026 and 5,000 NIS from June 2026.
claims.verification_note: The same source states the threshold amounts are computed before VAT (לפני מע"מ). No published source gives a 2027 value, so the previously listed January 2027 row was removed. The official ITA page at gov.il/he/departments/legalInfo/digital_invoice returns 403 to non-browser clients and needs a browser recheck.
